doc.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript

title: Are artists treated better today
summary: He says treatment is much better but depends on honest handlers.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Do you think artists are being better treated in general today than they were a couple of years ago?

Much better from the side that I see it. Some of them are still getting roughed up, you know. Like I see, it's the honesty and the person that's handling your affairs that makes your business what it is because all along they should have been getting treated real swell. But some of them bring things against themselves. I can only speak for myself. It's swell with me, you know.
